a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared
a "Server message" row to a server's page in `/mcp` that shows the JSON-RPC error message of a remote HTTP MCP server that refuses the connection
`"onFailure": "block"` for `mcp_tool` hooks, as for command and HTTP hooks: a hook whose call fails blocks the action
`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DEFERRED_TOOL_RESUME`, which lets a host stop `claude -p --resume` and `--continue` from running a tool call that a hook deferred
`claude mcp add-json <name> -` to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session
a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run `/rewind` and change the message, or run `/clear`
more.why: Keeps the useful part of a long session. Heavy /clear users usually lose context they wanted.
